description:
Swimming Pool Tiles 008 are star and cross pool tiles in blue with a beige and orange outline pattern, as the product photo shows, for a decorative pool, step or water feature with a traditional feel.

## How they look
The blue field carries a star-and-cross outline traced in beige and orange. The warm outline against the cool blue gives a Moroccan style pool tile look that tends to pair well with terracotta or brick surrounds, common in Pakistani courtyards and farmhouses.

## Where they work
- **Decorative pool floor tiles** for shallow areas, sun ledges and splash pools.
- **Fountains and courtyard water features**, where a pattern is seen up close.
- **Feature bands and step faces** in a pool lined in plain blue.

Blue patterned pool tiles are usually best on smaller areas or as a feature, so the pattern stays the centre of attention.

## Good to know
- Category: swimming pool tiles
- Look: blue with a beige and orange star-and-cross outline (from the product photo)
- Size, thickness and finish are not listed online yet; confirm them with your quote.

Dry-lay a section before fixing so the stars line up across the area, and use a pool-grade adhesive and grout. A beige grout tends to blend with the outline.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) and send your area and city for a dated quote. For the waterline, see the [blue and white pool border tiles](/products/swimming-pool-border-tiles), or browse the [swimming pool tiles range](/categories/swimming-pool-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of star and cross pool tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the pattern, the area to cover and delivery, so send your pool measurements and city on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can patterned tiles be used inside a pool?
faqs.a: Yes, they are commonly used for feature bands, steps, ledges and fountains. For a full lining, most owners keep the pattern to one area and use a plain blue elsewhere.

faqs.q: Do star and cross tiles suit a modern house?
faqs.a: They lean traditional. For a modern house they usually work best as a small feature, such as a fountain or step faces, alongside plain blue lining tiles.

faqs.q: How do I get a sample?
faqs.a: Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with the product name and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
